topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Hey, I heard about what's going on with you and the plagiarism thing. I can't even begin to tell you how much I believe in you. I know how hard you work, and it’s just not in you to cheat. Whoever's behind this needs to look a little deeper, because anyone who really knows you knows this is all some mix-up. You’ve got to keep your head up, okay? I’m here, and I’m going to do everything I can to help you sort this out. Just give me a shout whenever you need support or just someone to vent to. You’re not alone in this.
